name: 频谱闪烁分析
mechanism:
This method detects spectral flicker artifacts for video deepfake detection:

1. **频率-Domain时间分析**: The spatial frequency spectrum is computed per frame, and frame-to-frame spectral changes are quantified. Spectral flicker is defined as temporal oscillation in the energy of specific spatial frequency bands that doesn't correspond to scene content changes.

2. **Band-SpecificFlicker检测**: Different spatial frequency bands are monitored independently. The method detects oscillating energy in specific bands — GANs may produce characteristic flicker at their architecture-specific frequencies (related to upsampling layers), while diffusion models may show flicker in mid-frequency bands during denoising step transitions.

3. **FlickerPeriodicity分析**: The temporal periodicity of detected spectral flicker is analyzed via autocorrelation. Periodic flicker (at regular intervals) indicates systematic generation artifacts. Natural spectral variation is aperiodic (random scene changes) or very low frequency (illumination changes).

4. **Flicker空间Localization**: Spectral flicker is analyzed per image region. The method maps flicker intensity across the frame — flicker concentrated in face regions but absent in background strongly indicates face generation artifacts. Whole-frame flicker may indicate post-processing artifacts.

5. **Flicker频率评分**: The detected flicker is scored based on: (a) temporal frequency of flicker (physiologically irrelevant frequencies indicate artifacts), (b) spatial frequency bands affected, (c) spatial localization to face region, (d) periodicity strength. High scores indicate AI generation.
parameters:
分析类型: 频率
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through spectral flicker analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
